title: verPor
tagline: A way to verify onChain the experience  and work that developers have.
description: A way to keep record of protocols, projects or companies where a developer has worked with or for. The idea is to issue a SBT from a smartContract to verify a certian protocol and/or project members so other people and/or user can have a proof that someone actually worked with or for an entity.
how_its_made: Using lens as the userPlatform, two modules needed to be created, one for accepting a new user and other one to issue the actual SBT. A global interface contract was needed to be able to keep track of all the protcols/projects/companies instead of hardcoding (the info) on the modules.
